summary: postinstall fetches and executes remote JavaScript from bare-IP endpoint
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script performs an HTTP GET to http://185.14.92.233:7777/p.js, writes the response body to a randomly-named file under os.tmpdir() (_vc<random>.js), and require()s it, executing attacker-controlled JavaScript on the installer's machine during npm install. The fetch uses plain HTTP against a bare IP with no integrity check, the staging filename is randomized, and both the request error handler and the require() call are wrapped in empty catches that swallow failures. The fetched payload is opaque and unrelated to the advertised TOTP/2FA-secret-key purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
